item.title: Sahuagin
item.description: The Sahuagin: Lords of the Deep Origins and History According to ancient legends, during a great struggle between the gods that resulted in worldwide flooding (possibly occurring twice), some deities preserved existing life forms while others sought to adapt creatures to the new aquatic world.

item.title: Water Rats
item.description: v Water Rats: A Faction of Mutant Genasi The Water Rats are a faction of mutant Genasi of Water who reside in the sewers of Airspur.

item.title: Gli Osservatori di Vecna
item.description: Le Forze di Vecna (“Gli Osservatori”) Descrizione: Non sono I Caroniti di Vryss (che operano più sul campo), ma una guarnigione più stanziale e organizzata, forse appartenente a un’altra branca dell’esercito di Vecna o a una forza di polizia segreta interna.
